# Class diagram syntax

<!-- Generated by tools/gen-grammar from packages/diagram-class/grammar/class.ebnf. Do not edit: run `pnpm gen:grammar`. -->

Class diagram syntax (R-PARSE-9, D54): the normative grammar of `classDiagram` /
`classDiagram-v2` diagrams.

The hand-written parser in `src/parser/` implements it; `tools/gen-grammar` builds a reference
parser, highlighters and the syntax reference page from it. mermaid 12 decides what is valid,
this file is fixed to match, and the parser must match this file (DESIGN §4.4).

**Lexer input.** The lexer reads the diagram body as mermaid 12 handed it to its lexer: front
matter and `%%{…}%%` directives removed; CRLF read as LF; `="x"` inside an HTML tag read as
`='x'`; `%%` comment lines removed and leading blanks trimmed; on a line with `style…:…#…;`
(or `classDef…`) the last `;` dropped; `#name;` / `#123;` replaced by v12's entity
placeholders; and a line break appended. The token rules are v12's `classDiagram.jison` rules,
in its order (the first rule that matches wins).

## Grammar

EBNF: `[ x ]` is optional, `{ x }` repeats zero or more times, `x+` one or more times, `|` separates alternatives. Upper-case names and `subgraph`, `end`, `acc_…`, `direction_…` are tokens (see below). A rule marked `@Type` builds an AST node of that type.

A diagram is the header line, then statements, one per line.

```ebnf
classDiagram = Header NEWLINE statements EOF ;
```

```ebnf
Header @Header = CLASS_DIAGRAM ;
```

```ebnf
statements = statement { NEWLINE statement } [ NEWLINE ] ;
```

```ebnf
statement = Relation
          | MemberStatement
          | ClassRef
          | Namespace
          | Class
          | Annotation
          | Click
          | Style
          | CssClass
          | Note
          | ClassDef
          | Direction
          | AccTitle
          | AccDescr
          | MEMBER ;
```

Class names: words joined by `.` or written together, an optional generic type `~T~` last,
or a backtick-quoted name.

```ebnf
className = { alphaNumToken [ DOT ] } ( alphaNumToken [ GENERICTYPE ] | BQUOTE_STR [ GENERICTYPE ] ) ;
```

```ebnf
namespaceName = { alphaNumToken [ DOT ] } ( alphaNumToken | BQUOTE_STR ) ;
```

```ebnf
alphaNumToken = UNICODE_TEXT
              | NUM
              | ALPHA
              | MINUS ;
```

```ebnf
classLabel = SQS STR SQE ;
```

`A "1" *-- "many" B : label`: a relationship, with optional multiplicities and label.

```ebnf
Relation @Relation = className [ STR ] relation [ STR ] className [ LABEL ] ;
```

```ebnf
relation = [ relationType ] lineType [ relationType ] ;
```

```ebnf
relationType = AGGREGATION
             | EXTENSION
             | COMPOSITION
             | DEPENDENCY
             | LOLLIPOP ;
```

```ebnf
lineType = LINE
         | DOTTED_LINE ;
```

`A : +name type`: adds a member to the class.

```ebnf
MemberStatement @MemberStatement = className LABEL ;
```

A class name on its own line, which declares nothing.

```ebnf
ClassRef @ClassRef = className ;
```

`namespace Name { … }`: groups classes and notes.

```ebnf
Namespace @Namespace = NAMESPACE namespaceName [ classLabel ] STRUCT_START [ NEWLINE ] namespaceItem { NEWLINE namespaceItem } [ NEWLINE ] STRUCT_STOP ;
```

```ebnf
namespaceItem = Class
              | Note
              | Namespace ;
```

`class Name`, with an optional `["label"]`, then `:::style`, `<<annotation>>` or a body of
members in braces.

```ebnf
Class @Class = CLASS className [ classLabel ] [ classTail ] ;
```

```ebnf
classTail = STYLE_SEPARATOR alphaNumToken [ STRUCT_START MEMBER+ STRUCT_STOP ]
          | STRUCT_START { MEMBER } STRUCT_STOP
          | ANNOTATION_START alphaNumToken ANNOTATION_END [ STRUCT_START { MEMBER } STRUCT_STOP ] ;
```

`<<interface>> Name`: gives the class an annotation.

```ebnf
Annotation @Annotation = ANNOTATION_START alphaNumToken ANNOTATION_END className ;
```

`note for Class "text"` or `note "text"`.

```ebnf
Note @Note = NOTE_FOR className STR
           | NOTE STR ;
```

`classDef name fill:#f96`: defines a style class, given with `:::name` or `cssClass`.

```ebnf
ClassDef @ClassDef = CLASSDEF ALPHA { COMMA ALPHA } styles ;
```

`style Class fill:#f9f`: styles one class.

```ebnf
Style @Style = STYLE ALPHA styles ;
```

`cssClass "A,B" name`: gives classes a style class.

```ebnf
CssClass @CssClass = CSSCLASS STR ALPHA ;
```

```ebnf
styles = style { COMMA style } ;
```

```ebnf
style = ( ALPHA | NUM | COLON | SPACE | BRKT | STYLE | PCT | LABEL )+ ;
```

`callback Class "fn"`, `link Class "url"`, `click Class call fn()` or
`click Class href "url"`, with an optional tooltip; links take an optional target.

```ebnf
Click @Click = CALLBACK className STR [ STR ]
             | LINK className STR [ STR ] [ LINK_TARGET ]
             | CLICK className ( CALLBACK_NAME [ CALLBACK_ARGS ] [ STR ] | HREF STR [ STR ] [ LINK_TARGET ] ) ;
```

`direction LR`: the direction of the layout.

```ebnf
Direction @Direction = direction_tb
                     | direction_bt
                     | direction_rl
                     | direction_lr ;
```

`accTitle: …`: the accessible title of the diagram.

```ebnf
AccTitle @AccTitle = acc_title acc_title_value ;
```

`accDescr: …` or `accDescr { … }`: the accessible description of the diagram.

```ebnf
AccDescr @AccDescr = acc_descr acc_descr_value
                   | acc_descr_multiline_value ;
```

## Tokens

The lexer works in modes (`INITIAL` and the ones below). In each mode it tries the rules in this order and takes the first that matches; a rule may push a mode or pop back to the previous one. Rules without a token emit nothing.

Modes: `INITIAL`, `string`, `bqstring`, `generic`, `callback_name`, `callback_args`, `acc_title`, `acc_descr`, `acc_descr_multiline`, `class`, `class-body`, `namespace`, `namespace-body`.

| Modes | Token | Pattern | Action | Doc |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| INITIAL | direction_tb | `.*direction\s+TB[^\n]*` |  | `direction TB` (or `BT`, `RL`, `LR`): the whole line is one token. |
| INITIAL | direction_bt | `.*direction\s+BT[^\n]*` |  |  |
| INITIAL | direction_rl | `.*direction\s+RL[^\n]*` |  |  |
| INITIAL | direction_lr | `.*direction\s+LR[^\n]*` |  |  |
| INITIAL | — | `%%[^\n]*\n*` |  | A `%%` comment after other text on a line: skipped to the end of the line. |
| INITIAL | — | `%%[^\n]*\n*` |  |  |
| INITIAL | acc_title | `accTitle\s*:\s*` | push(acc_title) | `accTitle: …` and `accDescr: …` take the rest of the line; `accDescr { … }` runs to `}`. |
| acc_title | acc_title_value | `[^\n]*` | pop |  |
| INITIAL | acc_descr | `accDescr\s*:\s*` | push(acc_descr) |  |
| acc_descr | acc_descr_value | `[^\n]*` | pop |  |
| INITIAL | — | `accDescr\s*\{\s*` | push(acc_descr_multiline) |  |
| acc_descr_multiline | — | `\}` | pop |  |
| acc_descr_multiline | acc_descr_multiline_value | `[^}]*` |  |  |
| INITIAL | NEWLINE | `\s*(?:\r?\n)+` |  | Line breaks (blank lines included) separate statements; other blanks are skipped. |
| INITIAL | — | `\s+` |  |  |
| INITIAL | CLASS_DIAGRAM | `classDiagram-v2\b` |  | The header keyword. |
| INITIAL | CLASS_DIAGRAM | `classDiagram\b` |  |  |
| INITIAL | EDGE_STATE | `\[\*\]` |  |  |
| INITIAL | — | `call\s+` | push(callback_name) | `click <class> call name(args)`. |
| callback_name | — | `\(\s*\)` | pop |  |
| callback_name | — | `\(` | pop push(callback_args) |  |
| callback_name | CALLBACK_NAME | `[^(]*` |  |  |
| callback_args | — | `\)` | pop |  |
| callback_args | CALLBACK_ARGS | `[^)]*` |  |  |
| string | — | `"` | pop | Strings: `"…"`, in every mode; they may span lines and have no escapes. |
| string | STR | `[^"]*` |  |  |
| * | — | `"` | push(string) |  |
| INITIAL | STYLE | `style\b` |  | `style Class fill:#f9f,stroke:#333`: styles one class. |
| INITIAL | CLASSDEF | `classDef\b` |  | `classDef name fill:#f96`: defines a style class, given with `:::name` or `cssClass`. |
| INITIAL, namespace, namespace-body | NAMESPACE | `namespace\b` | push(namespace) | `namespace Name { … }`: groups classes and notes. |
| namespace | NEWLINE | `\s*(?:\r?\n)+` | pop |  |
| namespace | — | `\s+` |  |  |
| namespace | STRUCT_START | `\{` | push(namespace-body) |  |
| namespace | — | `(?=\})` | pop |  |
| namespace-body | STRUCT_STOP | `\}` | pop |  |
| namespace-body | EOF_IN_STRUCT | `$` |  |  |
| namespace-body | NEWLINE | `\s*(?:\r?\n)+` |  |  |
| namespace-body | — | `\s+` |  |  |
| namespace-body | EDGE_STATE | `\[\*\]` |  |  |
| INITIAL, namespace-body | CLASS | `class\b` | push(class) | `class Name`, with a body of one member per line in braces. |
| class | NEWLINE | `\s*(?:\r?\n)+` | pop |  |
| class | — | `\s+` |  |  |
| class | STRUCT_STOP | `\}` | pop pop |  |
| class | STRUCT_START | `\{` | push(class-body) |  |
| class-body | STRUCT_STOP | `\}` | pop |  |
| class-body | EOF_IN_STRUCT | `$` |  |  |
| class-body | EDGE_STATE | `\[\*\]` |  |  |
| class-body | OPEN_IN_STRUCT | `\{` |  |  |
| class-body | — | `\n` |  |  |
| class-body | MEMBER | `[^{}\n]*` |  |  |
| * | CSSCLASS | `cssClass\b` |  | `cssClass "A,B" name`: gives classes a style class. |
| * | CALLBACK | `callback\b` |  | `callback Class "function"`: runs a function on click. |
| * | LINK | `link\b` |  | `link Class "url"`: opens a link on click. |
| * | CLICK | `click\b` |  | `click Class call fn()` or `click Class href "url"`. |
| * | NOTE_FOR | `note for\b` |  |  |
| * | NOTE | `note\b` |  |  |
| * | ANNOTATION_START | `<<` |  |  |
| * | ANNOTATION_END | `>>` |  |  |
| * | HREF | `href\b` |  |  |
| generic | — | `~` | pop | Generic types `~T~` and backtick-quoted names `` `A::B` ``. |
| generic | GENERICTYPE | `[^~]*` |  |  |
| * | — | `~` | push(generic) |  |
| bqstring | — | ``` | pop |  |
| bqstring | BQUOTE_STR | `[^`]+` |  |  |
| * | — | ``` | push(bqstring) |  |
| * | LINK_TARGET | `_self\b` |  |  |
| * | LINK_TARGET | `_blank\b` |  |  |
| * | LINK_TARGET | `_parent\b` |  |  |
| * | LINK_TARGET | `_top\b` |  |  |
| * | EXTENSION | `\s*<\\|` |  | Relationship ends and lines. |
| * | EXTENSION | `\s*\\|>` |  |  |
| * | DEPENDENCY | `\s*>` |  |  |
| * | DEPENDENCY | `\s*<` |  |  |
| * | COMPOSITION | `\s*\*` |  |  |
| * | AGGREGATION | `\s*o\b` |  |  |
| * | LOLLIPOP | `\s*\(\)` |  |  |
| * | LINE | `--` |  |  |
| * | DOTTED_LINE | `\.\.` |  |  |
| * | LABEL | `:[^:\n;]+` |  | `: text` up to a `:`, `;` or line break: a member, or a relationship's label. |
| * | STYLE_SEPARATOR | `:::` |  | `class A:::name`: gives the class a style class. |
| * | MINUS | `-` |  |  |
| * | DOT | `\.` |  |  |
| * | PLUS | `\+` |  |  |
| INITIAL | COLON | `:` |  |  |
| INITIAL | COMMA | `,` |  |  |
| INITIAL | BRKT | `#` |  |  |
| INITIAL | BRKT | `#` |  |  |
| * | PCT | `%` |  |  |
| * | EQUALS | `=` |  |  |
| * | EQUALS | `=` |  |  |
| * | ALPHA | `\w+` |  |  |
| * | SQS | `\[` |  |  |
| * | SQE | `\]` |  |  |
| * | PUNCTUATION | `[!"#$%&'*+,\-.`?\\\/]` |  |  |
| * | NUM | `[0-9]+` |  |  |
| * | UNICODE_TEXT | `[\u00AA\u00B5\u00BA\u00C0-\u00D6\u00D8-\u00F6\u00F8-\u02C1\u02C6-\u02D1\u02E0…` |  | Letters outside ASCII (v12's `UNICODE_TEXT` class), one per token. |
| * | SPACE | `\s` |  |  |
| INITIAL | SPACE | `\s` |  |  |
| * | EOF | `$` |  |  |

Removed before lexing (highlighted only):

- COMMENT: `^[^\S\n]*%%(?!\{)[^\n]+`
- DIRECTIVE: `[^\S\n]*%%\{.*?\}%%`
